title: Smoky Tuna Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired stew made with smoky tuna, portuguese spices and a blend of international flavors.

ingredients.name: Portuguese tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or a mix of cumin, coriander and cinnamon

instructions: Heat oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and bell pepper and cook until tender.
Add tuna steaks and cook until browned on both sides.
Add tagine spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer the stew for 5-7 minutes or until the tuna is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or couscous.
